import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 限时活动 - 临时充值套餐查看
 * 指令：/活动充值
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/limitedEvent/recharge/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { EVENT_FOOTER, EVENT_HEADER } from '@src/response/limitedEvent/nav';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (!isPrivate) {
    md.addText('⚠️ 为了保护您的账号安全，活动充值相关信息仅在私聊中展示，请私聊发送指令查看');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '活动充值', header: EVENT_HEADER, content: md, footer: EVENT_FOOTER }));

    return;
  }

  const result = await App({ uid, bid });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '活动充值', header: EVENT_HEADER, content: md, footer: EVENT_FOOTER }));

    return;
  }

  const { packageList } = result.data;

  if (!packageList.length) {
    md.addText('当前没有进行中的活动充值套餐');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '活动充值', header: EVENT_HEADER, content: md, footer: EVENT_FOOTER }));

    return;
  }

  md.addText('活动套餐为临时套餐，仅有奖励和VIP经验，不触发普通充值权益。');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();

  for (const s of packageList) {
    md.addText(`💎 ${s.eventTitle} - ${s.subTitle}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();

    for (const tier of s.packages) {
      md.addBlockquote(
        addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`档${tier.tierLevel}：${tier.roundedYuanText}¥${tier.limitText}`), [
          { label: '购买', command: `/活动充值购买 ${s.subActivityId} ${tier.tierLevel}` }
        ])
      );

      if (tier.rewardTextParts.length > 0) {
        for (const rewardPart of tier.rewardTextParts) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${rewardPart}`));
        }
      } else {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('暂无奖励配置'));
      }

      md.addNewline();
    }
  }

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '活动充值', header: EVENT_HEADER, content: md, footer: EVENT_FOOTER }));
});
